messages:
Alison: Partner X reached out to onboard their secrets manager to our marketplace. they want SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, and KMS/HSM BYOK support. need quick alignment on scope.
Ravi: I can own the KMS/HSM checklist. question: will we require a vendor attestation or do we accept their certs?
Diego: they support SCIM groups -> role mapping. example mapping required. also they expose a rotation webhook that returns an opaque token (no versioning).
Marta: marketing wants a joint announcement ~2 weeks after listing. engineering needs final packaging + docs in ~10 business days.
Ken: legal asks for retention & dataflow docs plus any export controls. also confirm FIPS support.
Diego: SCIM example payload (users + group mapping):
```json
{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],"userName":"svc-redwood","externalId":"svc-1234","groups":[{"value":"inference-ops","display":"Inference Ops"}],"urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:enterprise:2.0:User":{"costCenter":"partner-x"}}
```
Diego: SAML metadata snippet for console import: 
```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://idp.partnerx.com">
  <IDPSSODescriptor>...cert...</IDPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```
Ravi: BYOK flow: partner will provide wrapped keys; we store only wrapped material. need confirmation that their HSM never exports raw key material. if not, we need additional controls.
Alison: product preference is partner-run compatibility shims. engineering: do we want to bundle an optional adapter in the marketplace image for opaque rotation tokens?
Diego: I can prototype an adapter that maps opaque_id -> internal version and handles webhook retries. pseudo: `on_rotate: map[opaque_id] = version++; fetch(secret_id, version_hint)`
Marta: marketplace packaging: we should reuse the connector template. ops-bot, where is it?
ops-bot: @Marta marketplace connector template: https://console.internal/templates/marketplace-secrets-connector tag rdx-marketplace-v1
Ken: action items: 
- Ravi: HSM attestation + dataflow statement (3 days)
- Diego: SCIM + SAML snippets + adapter prototype (2 days)
- Marta: package + CI + runbook (4 days)
- Alison: PR timeline + announcement draft (4 days)
Alison: can everyone ack by EOD so we freeze dates?
Diego: ack, starting SCIM/SAML examples now.
Ravi: ack, drafting attestation and FIPS compatibility note.
Marta: ack, will adapt template and confirm CI jobs.
Ken: ack, will coordinate legal/marketing checks.
Alison: I'll open a tracking ticket and move checklist there. ops-bot: create ticket?
ops-bot: Created ticket INF-9531 (partner-x marketplace onboarding) assigned to Alison, Diego, Ravi, Marta, Ken. https://jira.internal/browse/INF-9531
Alison: thanks all — scheduling a 15-min sync tomorrow to finalize. :calendar:
